productOnPage.description: Yoto Says: One of the world’s most famous texts, thoughtfully adapted for independent or family listening by The Good Book Company. Perfect for families looking for a child-friendly introduction to the Bible’s stories and values. Explore the big story of the Bible with this engaging audio collection, based on the popular God’s Big Promises Bible Storybook. Features 92 faithfully told stories that take young listeners on a journey through the Bible, from the very beginning to the very end.Each story is beautifully narrated by Andrew Wilson, easy to follow and full of meaning, helping children understand how the events in the Bible connect together as one big story full of hope and purpose.Written by Carl Laferton and illustrated by Jennifer Davison, this storybook has been praised for its clarity, warmth, and ability to explain deep truths in a way children can understand.A wonderful introduction to the Bible’s big message for families looking to share timeless stories and thoughtful values. Tracks included: Introduction In the Beginning In the Garden The Snake and the Tree Out of the Garden Noah Builds an Ark The First Rainbow The Tall Tower God's Promises to Abram Stars in the Sky A Baby at Last Jacob's Sneaky Trick Jacob's Special Dream Joseph in Trouble Joseph and the King of Egypt Joseph Meets His Brothers A Baby in the River Moses and the Burning Bush Let My People Go The Rescue from Egypt A Path Through the Sea God's Commands God's Tent Making a Not God Joshua Caleb and the Explorers Moses Sees the Land Rahab and the Explorers The Walls of Jericho Joshua Says Goodbye Deborah Barak and the Big Battle Samson Saves the Israelites Ruth Finds a Family Hannah's Special Son We Want a King God Chooses a King David and Goliath A King Forever King Solomon Things Go Very Wrong Elijah and the Fire A King Is Coming Jonah and the Big Fish Out of the Land Daniel in the Lion's Den The Brave Queen Back in the Land Again Outro
